input_contract: caller supplies precomputed viewport intersection state
caller supplies nonnegative CSS-pixel distance from the viewport for non-intersecting candidates
terminal style identity comes from the bounded computed-style DAG
selection_policy: viewport-intersecting candidates are excluded from offscreen pre-materialization
offscreen candidates beyond the configured lookahead are excluded
duplicate terminal styles collapse to their nearest offscreen occurrence
eligible unique styles are ordered by distance then terminal node identity
zero lookahead remains valid and admits zero-distance offscreen candidates only
certified_foundation: candidate scanning consumes the shared work budget
duplicate terminal lookup consumes the shared work budget
deterministic ordering consumes the shared work budget
candidate-count and work-budget failures preserve prior output atomically
temporary and retained selection storage use caller PMR
